title: Bar Ada the Surveyor
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was in charge of measuring land in Rava’s days, as in [Eruvin 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.56b.7): Rava said, “Bar Ada the surveyor explained it to me.” Hyman considers him undoubtedly the one mentioned in [Bava Metzia 107b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.107b.12): Rav Yehudah said to Rav Ada the surveyor, “Be careful,” etc.; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim cites from a manuscript of the Rif “Ada the surveyor.” Hyman infers that in Rav Yehudah’s days he was still young, and in Rava’s days he was an old man advanced in years, who explained [things] to Rava.[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=214&lang=en) gives both passages and asks whether Bar Ada is the surveyor’s actual name or a patronymic. Hyman’s identification and reconstruction of his age rely on reading the two notices together.
